{"facts":[{"topic":"日常评分系统的两个理由","claim":"讲者提出，与人互动会留下印象并受到评价，这是基本理念；因此希望给学生的每次表现即每堂课作出评价。第二个理由是，只要学生坚持并持续努力修这门课，就能展示很好的中文技能。基于这两个理由，他们在此采用日常评分系统。","quote":"Whenever you
have interaction with people,
you leave impressions.
You are evaluated.
So that's a very basic,
fundamental idea.
We want to give evaluation to
our students each performance.
That means each class.
And the second thing
is we are convinced
that, as long as students
are persistent and consistent
in their efforts to
take this course,
they can demonstrate very
good skills in Chinese.
So because of those two reasons,
we adopt a daily grading system
here.","qualifiers":["Whenever you
have interaction with people","as long as students
are persistent and consistent
in their efforts to
take this course","because of those two reasons"],"attribution":"HAOHSIANG LIAO","importance":"core"},{"topic":"课后反馈的内容与目的","claim":"通常课后会就每位学生的课堂表现提供反馈，包括语言和文化行为，以便学生知道下节课要改进什么。","quote":"So usually, after
class, we provide
feedback to each student's
performance in class--
including language, including
his cultural behavior--
so that students know what to
improve for the next sessions.","qualifiers":["usually","including language, including
his cultural behavior"],"attribution":"source","importance":"core"},{"topic":"书面反馈与Engrade网站","claim":"反馈通常以书面形式进行，使用名为Engrade的网站；除录入成绩外，还可私下给每位学生留言，学生只要登录其账户就能读到教师的评论。","quote":"We usually do written feedback.
So we use an online-- we have
a website called Engrade.
So besides entering grades,
you can also leave comments
to each student privately.
So each student, as
long as they get access
into their website
to their account,
they will read the comments
from the instructor.","qualifiers":["usually","as
long as they get access
into their website
to their account"],"attribution":"source","importance":"support"},{"topic":"评论内容取决于学生表现","claim":"评论内容取决于学生的表现，可以简单到提醒注意某些发音，也可以更详细一些。","quote":"So the comments--
it really depends
on the student's performance.
It can be as simple
as, you know, pay
attention to the
following pronunciations.
It can be a little
bit more elaborated.","qualifiers":["really depends
on the student's performance","can be as simple","It can be a little
bit more elaborated"],"attribution":"source","importance":"support"},{"topic":"详细反馈示例：如何应对称赞","claim":"更详细的反馈示例是让学生思考如何用中文应对称赞。","quote":"For example, think
about, how are you
going to deal with
compliments in Chinese?","qualifiers":["For example"],"attribution":"source","importance":"support"},{"topic":"美国文化中接受称赞的方式","claim":"在美国文化中，收到称赞时很自然地说谢谢，例如别人说你的中文很好，你回答谢谢；你的英文很好，也回答谢谢。","quote":"In American culture, when
you receive a compliment,
it's very natural for
you to say thank you.
For example, your
Chinese is very good.
You say, thank you.
Your English is good.
Thank you.","qualifiers":["In American culture","very natural","For example"],"attribution":"source","importance":"support"},{"topic":"中国文化中应对称赞需谦逊","claim":"在中国文化中，收到称赞时要保持谦逊，不以说谢谢来接受；有时会说还有很长的路要走、还差得远，或不知道称赞从何而来。讲者指出中国文化关于称赞的基本理念是保持谦逊。","quote":"However, being humble
is the way when
you receive a compliment
in Chinese culture.
You don't accept it
by saying thank you.
Sometimes you say things,
for example, like,
there's still a long way for
me to go, so it's too far.
Oh, I don't know where the
compliments come from. [LAUGHS]
So yeah, the fundamental
idea in Chinese culture
about compliments
is to remain humble.","qualifiers":["in Chinese culture","Sometimes","for example","the fundamental
idea in Chinese culture"],"attribution":"source","importance":"core"},{"topic":"针对L1表现的反馈方式","claim":"如果学生的课堂表现来自其母语（L1），教师会鼓励他们，并依据课堂所覆盖材料的教科书，让他们思考在中国文化中如何应对称赞，从而知道这是可以努力改进的地方。","quote":"So if the student's performance
in class is from his L1,
we will encourage
them and give them
the feedback by
thinking about, how
do you deal with compliments
in Chinese culture,
according to a textbook
where everything
is based on the materials
we cover in class?
So students can know
this is something
that they can work on.","qualifiers":["if the student's performance
in class is from his L1","according to a textbook
where everything
is based on the materials
we cover in class"],"attribution":"source","importance":"core"}]}
